title: param-lineage curated facts
description: What happened to each parameter that one PX4 release has and the next tracked release does not (data/curated/<from>..<to>.json). Written rather than extracted, each entry checked against the commit that removed the parameter; see docs/DESIGN.md.

format.description: Layout of this file. Changes when a field is added, renamed or removed.

status.description: complete: every parameter of 'from' that 'to' does not have is listed, and CI enforces it. partial: some are listed. not-started: none yet.

removed.description: One entry per removed parameter, by its name in 'from'.

kind.description: migrated: 'to' converts the stored value on in-place upgrade (must match its translations). renamed: a successor with the same meaning exists, but the value is not converted. replaced: newer parameters do the job in a different way, with no one-to-one mapping. fixed: the behaviour is now fixed in code. removed: the feature or setting is gone.

commit.description: The PX4 commit that removed the parameter.

pr.description: The PX4 pull request of that commit, when known.

successors.description: Parameters of 'to' that take over its job.

fixed_value.description: fixed: the value the behaviour is fixed at, when it equals an old setting.

note.description: What a user of 'from' needs to know, in plain English.
